per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet status remains complete-with-gaps historically, but local XML/PDF/OA package/SI/database surfaces were reopened and the owner-layer blocker was repairable from Table 3 plus source-reviewed database rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: Table 1 sequences and Table 3 MIC/MBC rows verify most DBAASP activity rows; Pseudomonas target-name conflict and figure-derived exact values are preserved as source_conflicts rather than smoothed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted: Table 3 was rebuilt into row-level MIC/MBC evidence for four AMPs and two antibiotic comparators, with source-supported biofilm and toxicity rows kept to text-supported values only.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions: direct membrane, DNA/oxidative damage, and penetration assays are source-located and classified without fabricating figure-only quantitative mechanism values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_decision: Accepted_with_cautions because all hard gate blockers were repaired, open rework targets are closed, and remaining source conflicts are explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper uses P. adaceae CICC 21958 in Table 3/methods while DBAASP uses Pseudomonas mendocina CICC 21958 for the matched CICC target rows.

DBAASP exact antibiofilm, S-4/L-4/P-4 hemolysis, and RAW264.7 cytotoxicity values are not all machine-readable exact values in local XML/PDF text; source-supported group claims are preserved separately.

Synthesis methods report C-terminal amidation for synthesized AMPs; Table 1 and merged DBAASP sequence letters are kept unchanged and modification is recorded as a note, not normalized into the sequence string.
Primary text supports >80% biofilm inhibition and >90% established-biofilm killing for the four AMPs, but not every exact per-peptide database bar value.

The packet status remains material_extracted_with_gaps because no standalone supplementary_original directory exists, but the OA package SI PDF/text and source XML/PDF were checked and no remaining worker-2/4/6 blocker remains.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the worker-2 Table 3 activity gap, reconciled worker-4 DBAASP rows against primary Table 1/3 and figure text, and closed worker-6 final review as accepted_with_cautions with nonblocking preserved conflicts.
summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the activity-table blocker and database adjudication gap; remaining database conflicts are preserved as cautions, not open rework.
